lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Good morning, and welcome back! It seems history has a habit of <color=red>repeating</color> itself.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Last night I gave a short talk on <color=red>palaeontology</color>, the study of ancient life, and the camp has been dinosaur-obsessed ever since.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: By dawn, every volume in the dinosaur section had been borrowed, and the borrowers have proved remarkably <color=red>elusive</color>.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: All that remains is a layer of dust, which feels rather <color=red>appropriate</color> for creatures that vanished sixty-six million years ago.

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Barnaby, Tilly and Gus each need a little help today. Would you be kind enough to <color=red>call on</color> them?

lines.speaker: Mr. Page
lines.text: Lend them a hand, and I suspect my books will find their way home, hopefully faster than a <color=red>lumbering</color> Brachiosaurus.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: The dinosaur section remains <color=red>conspicuously</color> empty, I'm sorry to say.

inProgressLines.speaker: Mr. Page
inProgressLines.text: Do carry on with Barnaby, Tilly and Gus, and return once all three have been <color=red>assisted</color>.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Extraordinary! The dinosaur section has been completely <color=red>replenished</color>.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: You helped every one of my friends, and I'm positively <color=red>jubilant</color>.

completeLines.speaker: Mr. Page
completeLines.text: Thank you, sincerely. Your help has been nothing short of <color=red>monumental</color>.

afterLines.speaker: Mr. Page
afterLines.text: The shelves are full of dinosaurs once more. Feel free to <color=red>delve</color> into them whenever you wish.
